gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: retainAll on a unique-indexed collection that holds one element, asked to retain an empty collection, removes the element and reports a change (true).
ADDED i3: retainAll on an empty collection makes no change and returns false.
ADDED i4: removeIf with a predicate that matches nothing leaves the single element in place and returns false.
ADDED i5: removeIf with an always-true predicate removes the single element and returns true.
ADDED i6: removeIf with a null predicate does nothing and returns false.
ADDED i7: remove on an empty collection finds nothing to remove and returns false.
ADDED i8: get returns null when the key is not present in the index.
ADDED i9: containsAll returns false when the collection holds an element that is not present in the index.
ADDED i10: containsAll returns true when every element of the collection is indexed.
ADDED i11: Adding an element to a unique-indexed collection whose key already exists throws IllegalArgumentException for the duplicate key.
ADDED i14: addAll copies every element of the source indexed collection into the target and reports a change (true).
ADDED i15: values returns null when the requested key is not present in the index.
ADDED i16: clear runs without error on an empty indexed collection.
ADDED i17: removeAll removes the single shared element and returns true.
